topology_note: AP1 connects to SW1 Fa0/24 (trunk). VLAN 99 (Guest) DHCP pool exists on R1. Corporate-WiFi (VLAN 10) works. AP1 serves both SSIDs.
expected_fault: The trunk port Fa0/24 on SW1 (connecting to the AP) only allows VLANs 1 and 10 — VLAN 99 (Guest) is not in the allowed list. Guest-WiFi DHCP DISCOVERs tagged for VLAN 99 are dropped at the switch. The correctly configured DHCP pool on R1 is a red herring.
